House Of KLynn Presents Gala Glamour Couture Runway Show.

Produced by IamMoody . Through creativity and impeccable taste, IamMoody has established itself as an excellent event planning team in the Twin Cities, Minneapolis, St. Paul and surrounding suburbs. With meticulous planning and a passion for perfection. IamMoody combines trendy ideas and international flair with elegance and sophistication, to deliver results that are full of color, texture and imagination.

Grand Couturier Kathyrn Rogers, who is known for making iconic couture clothing and accessories for critically-acclaimed feature films such as Hidden Figures, Passengers, and Bessie, and tailored for designer Zac Posen. Since the early 2000s, Rogers has consistently done fashion shows along the Vegas strip at MGM, Treasure Island, Caesars Place, Mandalay Bay, and Disney.

House Of KLynn promotes deliberate fashion. Made to order and size-inclusive to your personal measurements. Our clientele are at ease knowing that their order is consciously and intentionally being the change needed towards a more responsible fashion.

House Of KLynn is true couture architecture. The Gala Glamour Runway Collection will be showcasing all the impeccable silhouettes signatures of House Of KLynn couture craftsmanships opulent materials and iconic details.

“And that’s what I like about what I do, I want the woman to walk away, looking good at whatever shape or size she is.” – House Of KLynn Grand Couturier

To illuminate the fact that HOK inspires enthralling creativity, Bob J Hest has created a gallery of art inspired by the HOK Bold Beautiful Couture Collection to be featured at the Gala Glamour show.

Live performances by Singer Carolyn Naomi & DJ Cousin Christopher.

“If you weren’t lucky enough to witness the fabulous fashion show by House of KLynn in early April, you missed out on an incredible night”. – Samantha De Leon, MPLS St. Paul Magazine
